description.name: Entry
description.text: Grants [Tactical Awoken Mode], [Tactical Awoken Mode: Mustadio], [ATK +500 (25s) (Tactical)] to user.

description.name: Mode
description.text: Fire/Ice/Lightning/Poison abilities deal 30% more damage, have +10,000 damage cap, deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, trigger 2 additional times, have zero hone cost, triggers [111% ATB 1]/[125% ATB 1] after using Fire/Ice/Lightning/Poison abilities before/after triggering Weapon Skill while in Tactical Awoken Mode; removed if the character hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: Weapon Skill
description.text: One single piercing attack (11.00) capped at 199,999, ranged. Grants [Fire, Ice, Lightning, Poison Damage Cap +20000 (Tactical)], [Fire, Ice, Lightning, Poison 125% ATB Quick Cycle (Tactical)], [Instant ATB 1], [Instant Cast 1] to user, grants [Deadly Strikes +20% (15s)] to all allies if user has 100% Critical Rate, grants [100% Critical (15s)], [Critical Damage +50% (15s)] to all allies if not

description.name: Fire, Ice, Lightning, Poison Damage Cap +20000 (Tactical)
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap for Fire, Ice, Lightning, or Poison attacks by 20000, removed if the user hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: Fire, Ice, Lightning, Poison 125% ATB Quick Cycle (Tactical)
description.text: Grants [125% ATB 1] after using a Fire, Ice, Lightning, or Poison ability, removed if the user hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: 125% ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x1.25

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Deadly Strikes +20% (15s)
description.text: Critical hits deal 20% more damage (additive with the base critical coefficient and other Critical Damage statuses)

description.name: Critical Damage +50% (15s)
description.text: Critical hits deal 50% more damage (additive with the base critical coefficient)
